senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; Coptic p-ehe-mau, water-ox, Ges.) in Rabbin. lit. B’hemoth, a legendary animal reserved for the righteous in the hereafter; cmp. לִוְיָתָן.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:10">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> in place of the forbidden animals from which you here abstain, <he>ב׳ בהררי אלף</he> (I shall give you in the hereafter) ‘the b’hemoth on the thousand mountains’ (<cite ref="Psalms 50:10">Ps. L, 10</cite>).

<cite ref="Psalms 50:10">Ib.</cite> s. 13 <he>ב׳ ולויתן וכ׳</he> b’hemoth a. leviathan are the game of the righteous &c. Ib. <he>ב׳ נותץ וכ׳</he> b’hemoth shall attack the leviathan with his horns &c.
